4b1e8b3fa4.why: The comparison mask must remain in rdx, and constructing and scanning the combined mask already requires the remaining instructions.

cee6ecf505.why: The comparison, mask extraction, xmm2 clearing, zero test, and pointer update each produce a required result.

90dc7d3906.why: SSE2 requires separate instructions for the comparison, preserved scalar mask, zero flag, and pointer update.

7c47926455.why: The preserved loaded vectors and intermediate minimum prevent eliminating loads, while SSE2 still needs the mask extraction and zero test.

1a2d078e85.why: The vector comparison, preserved scalar mask, zero flag, and pointer adjustment require separate SSE2 instructions.

26e6c6ea08.why: The comparison and scalar mask are both preserved, and neither the zero test nor pointer adjustment can be removed.

4190238f3c.why: The memory comparison, preserved scalar mask, zero flag, and pointer adjustment already use one instruction each.

866fca55c1.why: All four vector clears and the full pointer copy are required, and the page-offset comparison still needs its copy, mask, and compare.

a48245d3ba.why: Preserving xmm0 requires a separate comparison destination, while the required rdx value prevents replacing mask extraction and testing with PTEST.

cc2a1c8bbc.rewrite:
movdqa xmm0,XMMWORD PTR [rax+0x40]
pminud xmm0,XMMWORD PTR [rax+0x50]
pminud xmm0,XMMWORD PTR [rax+0x60]
pminud xmm0,XMMWORD PTR [rax+0x70]
pcmpeqd xmm0,xmm3
ptest xmm0,xmm0
cc2a1c8bbc.why: The comparison produces only zero or all-one lanes, so PTEST gives the same ZF as extracting and testing the byte mask; rdx is dead.

fc2fa080e8.rewrite:

pcmpeqd xmm0,XMMWORD PTR [rax]
pcmpeqd xmm1,XMMWORD PTR [rax+0x10]
pcmpeqd xmm2,XMMWORD PTR [rax+0x20]
pcmpeqd xmm3,XMMWORD PTR [rax+0x30]
movdqa xmm4,xmm0
packssdw xmm4,xmm1
packssdw xmm2,xmm3
packsswb xmm4,xmm2
pmovmskb edx,xmm4
bsf rdx,rdx
shl rdx,0x2

sub rax,rdi

fc2fa080e8.why: Signed packing preserves the zero or minus-one comparison lanes and combines all sixteen into one byte mask. Scaling its first-set-bit index by four reproduces the original byte offset while retaining xmm0.

3bd9910f0a.why: AVX2 needs both comparisons and the AND-NOT to construct the required mask, in addition to the preserved load, extraction, and scalar comparison.

4630b1e48b.why: The nonzero mask and masked equality comparison are both needed, as are the required scalar mask transfer and length comparison.

a723ef7bdd.rewrite:
vptestmd k1,ymm21,ymm21
vpcmpeqd k0{k1},ymm22,ymm16
kmovd ecx,k0
shl r9d,0x8
lea r9d,[r9+rcx*1-0xff]
tzcnt r9d,r9d
cmp rdx,r9
a723ef7bdd.why: The mask lies in 0..255: below 255, its biased value has a nonzero low byte, so adding the shifted r9 preserves the same trailing-zero count as OR. At 255 the bias is zero, making both expressions identical.

1a043883ec.why: Each arithmetic instruction updates a distinct required register, and the final subtraction supplies the required flags.

cd9222444c.why: Scaling the bit index, inserting the sentinel, scanning, and converting to a dword count are all needed, as is clearing the preserved ymm0 upper half.

9b45aea5a6.why: The offset computation requires its addition, subtraction, and shift, while the vector comparison and final subtraction supply separate required results.

bfffa8c0d8.why: RORX and a five-bit mask extract bits 2 through 6 of the incremented pointer in two instructions, replacing the original copy, mask, and shift.

a7bd621116.why: The vector comparison, scalar mask extraction, trailing-zero count, and final carry-producing comparison are all required.
